name: dsh-bridge
description: Connect OpenAI Codex to DeepSeek Harness (DSH): delegate tasks to DSH and read its sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate tasks to DSH and read its sessions
interface.longDescription: Bridges Codex to DeepSeek Harness running on this machine. Codex can hand a self-contained task to DSH, continue that work in the same DSH session, review transcripts of earlier DSH runs, and diagnose the connection. DSH runs as a separate agent with its own tools and needs a DeepSeek API key.
